title: Cryptcanon Vestments
enchantDescription:
Adds 542 Maximum Magicka.
Adds 596 Maximum Health.
Adds 542 Maximum Stamina.
flavorText: Canons of the Dark Elf faith must learn to interpret the wisdom of the ancestors, a complex and subtle source of power. They must respect the thousands of departed over any single living soul, the weight of tradition emphasizing the many over the few.
name: Cryptcanon Vestments

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) You can no longer cast Ultimate abilities. Instead, casting an Ultimate ability transfers your Ultimate resource to your living group members, divided equally among them.

Gain Minor Heroism while you are in combat.

traitDescription: Increase armor enchantment effect by 25%.

title: Esoteric Environment Greaves
enchantDescription: Adds 954 Maximum Health.
flavorText: The zeal of Dwemer researchers was legendary. Runes along the heel read: "Proof against magma, frost, ichor, poison, aetheric debris, necromancy, high pressure, claudication, temporal reallocation, and Daedric corruption."
name: Esoteric Environment Greaves

setBonuses.description: (1 item) While you are above |cffffff50|r% Stamina, reduce your direct damage taken by 50% and lose 968 Stamina whenever you take direct damage, up to once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Block by 4%.

title: Torc of the Last Ayleid King
enchantDescription:
Adds |cffffff84|r Magicka Recovery.
Adds |cffffff84|r Health Recovery.
Adds |cffffff84|r Stamina Recovery.
flavorText: The "lordly elves" were arrogant beyond measure. This symbol, rumored to have been worn by their final ruler, is powerful. But brooks no competing magics.
name: Torc of the Last Ayleid King

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff15|r%. 
Adds |cffffff1337|r Weapon and Spell Damage.
Adds |cffffff500|r Magicka and Stamina Recovery.
Disable all other item set bonuses.

setName: Torc of the Last Ayleid King
traitDescription: Increases Maximum Magicka by |cffffff439|r, Maximum Stamina by |cffffff439|r, and Maximum Health by |cffffff482|r.

title: Velothi Ur-Mage's Amulet
enchantDescription:
Adds |cffffff174|r Weapon and Spell Damage.
Adds |cffffff10|r Magicka Recovery.
flavorText: Among the followers of Veloth were counted mages and spellsmiths of unparalleled skill. Their vision of overwhelming arcane might is woven, lattice after lattice, into this talisman.
name: Velothi Ur-Mage's Amulet

setBonuses.description: (1 item) Increase your damage done to monsters by |cffffff15|r%, gain Minor Force at all times, increasing your Critical Damage done by |cffffff10|r%, and reduce your Light and Heavy Attack damage by |cffffff99|r%.

traitDescription: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage against enemies under |cFFFFFF90|r% Health by up to |cffffff350|r.

setBonuses.description: (3 items) Gain Minor Aegis at all times, reducing your damage taken from Dungeon, Trial, and Arena Monsters by 5%.

title: Apocrypha Fossil, Bones Large
flavorText: Though you may not ever find out what creature these bones belong to, they're a must-have for any ossuary garden or, if you're more traditional in your reliquiae displays, fossil collection.
name: Apocrypha Fossil, Bones Large

title: Apocrypha Fossil, Nautilus
flavorText: Lovers of large fossils, rejoice! This enormous nautilus fossil can serve as the backdrop for your next outdoor gathering.
name: Apocrypha Fossil, Nautilus

title: Apocrypha Fossil, Worm
flavorText: Faithful of Mora believe that the fossils embedded across the realm of Apocrypha are remnants of another place, another realm, the origin point of the Daedric Prince of Knowledge. Certainly, they correspond to no creatures native to Tamriel.
name: Apocrypha Fossil, Worm

title: Apocrypha Fossil, Arch
flavorText: This arching fossil may have once belonged to a gigantic creature of Apocrypha, but now it can serve as an archway within your home.
name: Apocrypha Fossil, Arch

title: Telvanni Alchemy Station
flavorText: With components inspired by a variety of cultures, this alchemy station not only helps you mix all manner of ingredients into useful potions, but also adds a touch of all things Tamriel to your home.
name: Telvanni Alchemy Station

title: Trifold Mirror of Alternatives
flavorText: "May your wardrobe reflect the dark sophistication of this mirror trio. It's not my style, but when I look deeply into your eyes, I think it suits you more than you may think."—Fairwen of Vulkhel Guard
name: Trifold Mirror of Alternatives

title: Apocryphal Well
flavorText: The liquid in this well never stills and resembles a roiling portal to the realm of Hermaeus Mora.
name: Apocryphal Well

title: Cliff Strider Skeleton Stand
flavorText: Set up this experiment in taxidermy and Cliff Strider anatomy in your home—just make sure to warn any guests about it before they enter its space. It's a bit … startling.
name: Cliff Strider Skeleton Stand

title: Tribunal Window, Stained Glass
flavorText: Bring the light of the Tribunal into your home with this stained glass window. Featuring rich colors, this sacred art piece can serve as the focal point of your personal shrine to ALMSIVI.
name: Tribunal Window, Stained Glass

title: Mushroom Classification Book
flavorText: Flip through the illustrated pages of this Telvanni library staple. While it may not share the deep knowledge that mycoturges possess, it can serve as an entertaining conversation starter at your next gathering.
name: Mushroom Classification Book

title: Antique Map of the Telvanni Peninsula
flavorText: The fine detail work on the coastlines contrasts strongly with inland portions of the map. Almost as if House Telvanni had little interest in a truly accurate depiction of the peninsula.
name: Antique Map of the Telvanni Peninsula

title: Antique Map of Apocrypha
flavorText: "Mapping Apocrypha and expecting the result to help anyone else is foolish. Instead consider the map to be more of a visual guide to the cartographer's experiences there—unique to them alone."—Excerpt from an unknown Cipher's Journal
name: Antique Map of Apocrypha

title: Tribunal Rug
flavorText: This is a standard house item.
name: Tribunal Rug

title: Necrom Stele, Ceremonial
flavorText: Raised only to venerate ancestors that have shaped the very fabric of a family line. Ensure your forbearers are pleased by making this classic stele the focal piece of your own shrine.
name: Necrom Stele, Ceremonial

title: Crystalline Mind Barrier, Replica
flavorText: Replicated painstakingly via rough description by the very few that have returned from the nightmare realms of Vaermina, this barrier is a reminder of a dark and challenging mind-realm far from the light of day.
name: Crystalline Mind Barrier, Replica

title: Apocrypha Altar, Lighted
flavorText: Some scholars of Apocrypha claim that if you meditate at one of its altars, a stray piece of lost knowledge may find its way into your mind. Will this work in your home? Probably not, but you'd look suitably impressive while meditating.
name: Apocrypha Altar, Lighted

title: Necrom Archway
flavorText: Accents of green on white stone decorate this solid archway. Anything beyond it must surely be worth seeing given its elegantly dramatic appearance.
name: Necrom Archway

title: Apocrypha Courtyard Pool
flavorText: The visions one could scry within the pools of Apocrypha sometimes cause a viewer's mind to shatter. Thankfully for you, this particular pool looks stunning, but provides no mind-breaking visions.
name: Apocrypha Courtyard Pool

title: Hermaeus Mora Banner
flavorText: No one can entertain doubts as to your affiliation when you hang this banner featuring the Golden Eye's symbols in your home.
name: Hermaeus Mora Banner

title: The Lord of Fate and Knowledge Frieze
flavorText: Place this frieze of the Keeper of Forbidden Knowledge in a prominent place. Perhaps the One Who Knows will look upon you with favor and share some curious bit of information when you most need it. Or, perhaps not.
name: The Lord of Fate and Knowledge Frieze

title: Apocrypha Portal Seal, Replica
flavorText: If this were a real portal seal in your abode, you may end up questioning your life choices. As it stands, this replica serves as a marvelous accent in any space.
name: Apocrypha Portal Seal, Replica

title: Apocrypha Stalk, Scryeball
flavorText: Feel as if you're being watched? With these bizarre stalks around, you are. Each stalk adds an element of oddball ambience to wherever you choose to plant it.
name: Apocrypha Stalk, Scryeball

title: Tales of Tribute Kit, Travel
flavorText: A testament to the increasing popularity of this Roister's club favorite, this travel kit shows your love of Tales of Tribute to all and sundry that visit your home.
name: Tales of Tribute Kit, Travel

title: Replica Fateweaver Key
flavorText: A recreation by Azandar al-Cybiades to honor the research adventure of a lifetime.
name: Replica Fateweaver Key

title: Dormant Tyranite Calx
flavorText: This broken, brittle shard of tyranite calx is empty of magic and cool to the touch. Should the metal's dormancy ever change, you will be the first to know.
name: Dormant Tyranite Calx

title: Azandar Research Note # 1
flavorText: Must establish observational control once Key functional. Cannot be stuck observing fateline for Azandar the camel herder.
name: Azandar Research Note # 1

title: Azandar Research Note # 2
flavorText: References to other fateline methodologies proven frustrating. Fate shaping is impossible, nothing but dead ends.
name: Azandar Research Note # 2

title: Azandar Research Note # 3
flavorText: Ensure mystic binding only applies to my fateline; safety in specificity when it comes to high arcanum.
name: Azandar Research Note # 3

title: Azandar Research Note # 4
flavorText: Research indicates potential for use of fatelines as power source. Immoral, repugnant, unseemly. But interesting.
name: Azandar Research Note # 4

title: Azandar Research Note # 5
flavorText: Send message to Martina after first successful test, Key may fuel social interaction with lessened awkwardness.
name: Azandar Research Note # 5

title: Azandar Research Note # 6
flavorText: Dwemer tonal concepts as core influence suggests further Deep Elf techniques may be of utility to explore.
name: Azandar Research Note # 6

title: Azandar Research Note # 7
flavorText: Send a formal gloating treatise to Shad Astula after experiment success, or request a lecture series?
name: Azandar Research Note # 7

title: Azandar Research Note # 8
flavorText: Full incorporation of tonal architecture into Fateweaver structure proving challenging. More exploration and research required.
name: Azandar Research Note # 8

title: Azandar Research Note # 9
flavorText: Months wasted exploring familial connection to fatelines; will be years before I can stomach my brother's cooking again.
name: Azandar Research Note # 9

title: Azandar Research Note # 10
flavorText: Worth attempting entry to Clockwork City, extra-Nirn structures could prove excellent touchpoint for Fateweaver structure.
name: Azandar Research Note # 10

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 1
flavorText: I find the Abyssal Sea meditative. Once you adjust to organelles thrumming across the length of your body, it's quite peaceful.
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 1

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 2
flavorText: I simply don't understand the average mortal's aversion to tentacles. They seem incredibly useful, if nothing else!
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 2

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 3
flavorText: I have, by my count, perfected thirty eight different runeforms and counting. Onward and upward!
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 3

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 4
flavorText: My tome is playing a game of hide and seek. Vexing. Will have to check Wayrest Cathedral again, seems to be a favorite spot.
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 4

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 5
flavorText: I was awakened last night by Hermaeus Mora intoning pleas and threats from my tome. I threw it across the room and rolled over.
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 5

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 6
flavorText: The Baron of the Breakers was in my dreams again last night, offering power. I asked for tea. He was not amused.
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 6

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 7
flavorText: I summoned the Fate Crone, and we spoke at length. The ancient hag is a pleasant conversationalist, but not very forthcoming.
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 7

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 8
flavorText: Encountered Daedric entity Blind Man in antihelix of the Wind. Marked corridor to avoid, knowledge not worth the danger.
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 8

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 9
flavorText: My background studies into the rune knights of old resulted in little more than curious, open ended ephemera.
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 9

title: Azandar Arcanist Note # 10
flavorText: Finally accepted the whispers and spent an evening meditating before the Colorless Pool. Burned notes after.
name: Azandar Arcanist Note # 10

title: Azandar Scribbled Notes #1
flavorText: New leaf blend still needs something. Rolled oats may prove a textural and flavor compliment.
name: Azandar Scribbled Notes #1

title: Azandar Scribbled Notes #2
flavorText: Months since I last yanked Telenger's chain. Something with that Dwemer monstrosity in the Skywatch plaza? Worth exploring.
name: Azandar Scribbled Notes #2

title: Azandar Scribbled Notes #3
flavorText: (each has a scribbled line through it) Coldharbour, Apocrypha, Evergloam, Colored Rooms, Deadlands, Spiral Skein
name: Azandar Scribbled Notes #3

title: Azandar Scribbled Notes #4
flavorText: Need social interactions outside of research partners. Make Interaction Plan to encourage social connections.
name: Azandar Scribbled Notes #4

title: Azandar Scribbled Notes #5
flavorText: Atronach name options: Piffle, Bartolo, Fribbish, Gubbins, Nukks, Pompom, Springle
name: Azandar Scribbled Notes #5

name: Furnishing Pack: Hubalajad's Final Treasure

title: Furnishing Pack: Dibella's Garden
flavorText: The Lady of Love, Art, and Affection teaches us to treasure the gifts of friendship and to open our hearts to the mysteries of love. In her divine words, "No matter the seed, if the shoot is nurtured with love, will not the flower be beautiful?"
name: Furnishing Pack: Dibella's Garden

title: Furnishing Pack: Tyrants of the Merethic Era
flavorText: These relics date back to the height of the Dragon Cult's power, long before the bloody revolution of the Dragon War. Though this particular Dragon's name is long forgotten, its story is still told by the ancient friezes found in its barrow.
name: Furnishing Pack: Tyrants of the Merethic Era

title: Furnishing Pack: Trappings of Mephala Worship
flavorText: With these furnishings, some from Mephala cultists, some that replicate the bizarre environment of the Spiral Skein, you can adopt the ambience of the realm of the Webspinner.
name: Furnishing Pack: Trappings of Mephala Worship

title: Summerset Noble's Bedroom Pack
flavorText: Decorate your bedchambers in the style of Alinor nobility with this selection of masterfully crafted furnishings.
name: Summerset Noble's Bedroom Pack

title: Summerset Noble's Kitchen Pack
flavorText: Sup in Elven sophistication with this selection of everything needed to emulate the ambience of Alinor fine dining.
name: Summerset Noble's Kitchen Pack

title: Summerset Noble's Parlor Pack
flavorText: Hold court in your own living room with this selection of elegant furnishings in the style of Alinor nobility.
name: Summerset Noble's Parlor Pack

title: Summerset Noble's Bathing Pack
flavorText: Whether bathing in luxurious solitude or relaxing with a partner, this two-person sauna and selection of washroom accessories is perfect for those leisurely afternoon soaks.
name: Summerset Noble's Bathing Pack

title: Furnishing Pack: Sinister Hollowjack Items
flavorText: Lanterns lure and pumpkins trip
name: Furnishing Pack: Sinister Hollowjack Items

title: Furnishing Pack: New Life Festival
flavorText: Welcome your friends with these essential New Life decorations, complete with ice sculptures, Bounteous Ladles for the younger guests, a hearth for roasting festive feasts, and even a trio of snowmortals!
name: Furnishing Pack: New Life Festival

title: Furnishing Pack: Shadow and Stone
flavorText: By my hand blood enters the Marsh. By my deed the Marsh is fed and grows fertile. By my silent watch the Hist may thrive. Honor my doings, O Sithis, for my brethren show me but fear. Guard me not, O Sithis, for only my own strength honors you.
name: Furnishing Pack: Shadow and Stone

title: Furnishing Pack: Deepmire Expedition
flavorText: The strange heart of Murkmire holds forgotten ruins, curious plants, bizarre creatures, and no end of peril. A safe return from such an expedition is sure to benefit the research of any scholar—or the gallery of any courageous adventurer.
name: Furnishing Pack: Deepmire Expedition

title: Furnishing Pack: Forge-Lord's Great Works
flavorText:
"In the Deep Halls, Far from Men
Forsaken Red Mountain, Twisted Kin
Hail the Mind, Hail the Stone
Dwarven Pride, Stronger than Bone"
- Dwemer Inquiries I-III, Thelwe Ghelein
name: Furnishing Pack: Forge-Lord's Great Works

title: Furnishing Pack: Moon-Bishop's Sanctuary
flavorText: Display your reverence for the Moons with this assortment of clerical Elsweyr furnishings. Luxurious tapestries, tasteful furniture, and even a target dro-m'Athra will make your home the envy of Khajiiti adepts everywhere.
name: Furnishing Pack: Moon-Bishop's Sanctuary

title: Furnishing Pack: Moons-Blessed Oasis
flavorText: Bring the stark beauty of an Anequine oasis to your courtyard with this bundle of Elsweyr plants and statuary, complete with a luminous fountain blessed by Jone and Jode.
name: Furnishing Pack: Moons-Blessed Oasis

title: Furnishing Pack: Khajiiti Life
flavorText: Moon-sugar farming implements and wares, an alchemy station, a merchant tent, and more await you in this bundle. Each item represents a slice of Khajiiti life, enabling you to live like the Moons-blessed moon-sugar lover you are!
name: Furnishing Pack: Khajiiti Life

title: Furnishing Pack: Heart's Day Retreat
flavorText: Set the scene properly for Heart's Day with this romantic furniture bundle, which includes flowers, sweetrolls, and more! Each item helps those so inclined fulfill on the day's delightful promise with their partners in the adventure called life.
name: Furnishing Pack: Heart's Day Retreat

title: Furnishing Pack: Vampiric Libations
flavorText: Slake your undying thirst within your own estate. With a willing thrall at hand, you need never go without a tasty meal. And, for those times when you wish to tame your unceasing hunger, sip from an ancient basin that promises succor … of a sort.
name: Furnishing Pack: Vampiric Libations

title: Furnishing Pack: Mad Alchemist
flavorText: At last, you can demonstrate your true genius! Enhance your laboratory with these tanks and specimens then experiment to your heart's content! And, because the simple-minded may fear your work, keep your combat arts well-honed on a sturdy Bloodknight.
name: Furnishing Pack: Mad Alchemist

title: Furnishing Pack: Chapel of Zenithar
flavorText: Though Zenithar is known as the God of Work and Commerce, he also represents the peace and prosperity that comes with great effort. Now you can decorate your own place of worship to venerate this industrious Divine.
name: Furnishing Pack: Chapel of Zenithar

title: Furnishing Pack: Windows of the Divines
flavorText: When light filters through these artistic stained-glass representations of the Eight Divines, the play of hues can inspire reverential awe—perfect for your chapel or other sacred spaces.
name: Furnishing Pack: Windows of the Divines

title: Furnishing Pack: Steam Bath Serenity
flavorText: Pamper yourself by creating a relaxing retreat away from the travails of Tamriel! Featuring a replica of the alluring Mermaid of Anvil statue, this bundle includes burbling fountains, luscious greenery, comfortable seating, and more.
name: Furnishing Pack: Steam Bath Serenity

title: Furnishing Pack: Daedric Ambitions
flavorText: Build your own imposing edifices with these structural pieces and accessories. Will your enemies—and maybe even friends—quail at the results of your labors? Yes, yes, they will.
name: Furnishing Pack: Daedric Ambitions

title: Furnishing Pack: Fargrave Bazaar
flavorText: Bring Fargrave's Bazaar to your own abode with this collection of curious commodities. Floating books, suspicious specimens, drifting globules, and more await your mercantile merriment.
name: Furnishing Pack: Fargrave Bazaar

title: Furnishing Pack: Aquatic Splendor
flavorText: Add oceanic depth to your abode with this seaworthy arrangement of home furnishings. An abundance of vibrant coral and kelp, effervescent bubbles and jellyfish, and even a mudcrab sparring partner can turn your home into a deep-sea wonderland.
name: Furnishing Pack: Aquatic Splendor

title: Furnishing Pack: Equipment Stations
flavorText: Enjoy crafting gear and furnishings in the comfort of your own amazing abode! With a blacksmithing station, clothing station, and woodworking station at your fingertips, you can don new armor and indulge in personalizing your home with ease.
name: Furnishing Pack: Equipment Stations

title: Furnishing Pack: Consumables Stations
flavorText: Mix potions, create enchantments, prepare food, and more with this trio of crafting stations. After placing the alchemy station, enchanting station, and provisioning station, you can craft a wide range of consumables and furnishings in your home.
name: Furnishing Pack: Consumables Stations

title: Furnishing Pack: Maormer Boarding Party
flavorText: The Sea Elves rule the waves, but you've beaten them just the same. Celebrate your victory in battle by furnishing your home with "liberated" serpentine items, including a raiding party tent and a Maormer ship's prow!
name: Furnishing Pack: Maormer Boarding Party

title: Furnishing Pack: Shad Astula Scholars
flavorText: These two scholarly statues from Shad Astula serve not only as decorative elements, but also as foci for lessons. Each one allows those so inclined to study the magical energies of Alteration, Conjuration, Destruction, Illusion, and Restoration.
name: Furnishing Pack: Shad Astula Scholars

title: Bound Style Page: Gravegrasp Cuirass
flavorText: Grants an Outfit Style Collectible. Once used, the Outfit Style is available to all characters on your account. Outfit Styles can be used at an Outfit Station to customize your appearance.
name: Bound Style Page: Gravegrasp Cuirass

title: Kagouti Anatomical Drawing
flavorText: A thorough depiction of every bone, muscle group, and major blood vessel inside the standard kagouti.
name: Kagouti Anatomical Drawing

title: Ivory Keeper Figure
flavorText: Roughly carved, but clearly a Keeper. The tentacles are all the same length so it can stand on a table.
name: Ivory Keeper Figure

title: Painted Sea Stone
flavorText: A oval stone worn smooth by the Padomaic Ocean's waves. Stars and waves are painted on it in bright colors.
name: Painted Sea Stone

title: Onyx Relief Portrait of Blessed Almalexia
flavorText: Almalexia's face sculpted in profile from black gemstone. Her face expresses a fierce determination.
name: Onyx Relief Portrait of Blessed Almalexia

title: Bejewled Paint Jar
flavorText: While the jar's purpose is holding paint, the quality of the affixed gems and the lack of stain suggests it's only decorative.
name: Bejewled Paint Jar

title: Healing Cloth of Mora
flavorText: Embroidered with bizarre iconography depicting Mora as a kind of healing saint. Intended to be applied to the forehead.
name: Healing Cloth of Mora

title: Antecedent Scholar's Votive
flavorText: This short red candle mixes Dark Elf and Hermaeus Mora symbology upon wax from a questionable source.
name: Antecedent Scholar's Votive

title: Sensory Isolation Mask
flavorText: Some followers of Mora cover both eyes and ears with this mask, ensuring they can better perceive their lord's whispers.
name: Sensory Isolation Mask

title: Silver Servitude Bracelet
flavorText: Mortal servants of vampires sometimes wear these as a signal of ownership to other vampires.
name: Silver Servitude Bracelet

title: Vitality Extraction Quill
flavorText: An ensorcelled writing implement which can pierce skin and absorb blood to sign dangerous pacts with Daedra.
name: Vitality Extraction Quill

title: Torch of Abiding Flame
flavorText: Although claims of a fire that never goes out may be overstated, cultists rely on this type of torch when lighting lairs.
name: Torch of Abiding Flame

title: Chant Inversion Table
flavorText: Reversing the words in mystical chants is common practice for dark rituals, and this chart makes the process easier.
name: Chant Inversion Table

title: Strider Oil Concealer
flavorText: A thick gel used to cover up blemishes. Smells surprisingly pleasant.
name: Strider Oil Concealer

title: Fossilfoam Lather
flavorText: A soap product made from ground fossils. Excellent for exfoliation and troublesome skin conditions.
name: Fossilfoam Lather

title: Violet-Scented Foot Powder
flavorText: A fine, purple dust with a pleasant scent. A daily dusting into your boots can fight off the worst odors.
name: Violet-Scented Foot Powder

title: Rune-etched Hair Clip
flavorText: A beautiful hair clip etched with the runes of the Baron of Breakers, a secretive figure from Apocryphal lore.
name: Rune-etched Hair Clip

title: Malachite Tincture Bottle
flavorText: Used to carry medications on the road without spillage. The tough glass reduces the chance of shattering.
name: Malachite Tincture Bottle

title: Powdered Berry Rouge
flavorText: Dried red berries are crushed and blended with ash to create a deep red cosmetic.
name: Powdered Berry Rouge

title: Known Trader Catalogue
flavorText: Traders and shopkeeps use these books exclusively to record names and addresses of people who they wish to do business with.
name: Known Trader Catalogue

title: Sulfurous Accent Fluid
flavorText: A thin yellow fluid that can be applied to text for emphasis of certain words. Rarely used due to the smell.
name: Sulfurous Accent Fluid

title: Cliffracer Bone Quill
flavorText: Despite the lack of plumage, the light, hollow bones of the flying cliffracer make for cost-effective quills.
name: Cliffracer Bone Quill

title: Defaced Writs of Execution
flavorText: A small stack of Morag Tong writs that were partially filled out, then had ink poured on them, rendering them useless.
name: Defaced Writs of Execution

title: Blank Library Cartulary
flavorText: A small blank book intended for use to catalogue the books in your library. Has space for several hundred tomes.
name: Blank Library Cartulary

title: Guar Leather Desk Blotter
flavorText: Thick leather that lays flat on a desk and protects it from spills or scratches.
name: Guar Leather Desk Blotter

title: Argonian Tail Spoon
flavorText: When your Argonian chef needs an extra set of hands to prepare dinner, this spoon attaches to the tail and helps stir the stew.
name: Argonian Tail Spoon

title: Steel Roasting Skewer
flavorText: This skewer can collapse to fit into your backpack for when you might need to roast dinner on the road.
name: Steel Roasting Skewer

title: Cephalopod Cutlery
flavorText: An extra sharp knife, a fork, and a spike intended to keep a writhing tentacle in place as you carve it.
name: Cephalopod Cutlery

title: Sturdy Meal Tongs
flavorText: Some unique dishes require the food still be alive. These tongs help control the wriggling as it enters your mouth.
name: Sturdy Meal Tongs

title: Chef's Hand Towel
flavorText: Although they cost a little extra, people serious about their foodcraft keep these absorbent towels handy at all times.
name: Chef's Hand Towel

title: ALMSIVI Spice Shakers
flavorText: A set of three. Almalexia contains a sweetener, Vivec a spicy pepper, and Sotha Sil the salt.
name: ALMSIVI Spice Shakers

title: Ivory Hair Detangler
flavorText: A gentler version of the classic Knot Rake, some more vain werewolves use this to keep their hair smooth and luxurious.
name: Ivory Hair Detangler

title: Oversized Animal Collar
flavorText: Very similar in design to a typical dog collar, this one appears nearly ten times as large and uses thick iron straps.
name: Oversized Animal Collar

title: Howling Practice Horn
flavorText: Some newer werewolves haven't perfected their howls. This allows them to practice without embarrassment.
name: Howling Practice Horn

title: Chewed Skull Necklace
flavorText: Skulls from various creatures strung together on a leather strap. Each skull bears noticeable teeth marks.
name: Chewed Skull Necklace

title: Hircine Wishing Claw
flavorText: Legend has it that if a wish is made while holding this severed claw, Hircine will grant it but at a cost.
name: Hircine Wishing Claw

title: Sun-blocking Sleep Mask
flavorText: Since the lycanthrope's condition keeps them awake all night, this mask helps them sleep while the sun is out.
name: Sun-blocking Sleep Mask

title: Sonic Insect Repeller
flavorText: Wind up this device and put it in your kitchen. It emits a sound too shrill for the average person, but keeps insects at bay.
name: Sonic Insect Repeller

title: Travel-Sized Leather Bellows
flavorText: One never knows under what circumstances you'll need to keep a fire alive. This bellows will work under any adverse conditions.
name: Travel-Sized Leather Bellows

title: Self-Rotating Hourglass
flavorText: Once the sand fills the bottom chamber, this hourglass automatically reverses itself and starts the timer again.
name: Self-Rotating Hourglass

title: Silt Strider Driving Hooks
flavorText: These prongs hook onto the driver's fingers, then extend into the strider organs which make locomotion possible.
name: Silt Strider Driving Hooks

title: Silver Framed Barometer
flavorText: Careful scholars keep these in their laboratories to account for air pressure in their mystical research.
name: Silver Framed Barometer

title: Dwarven Thermoscope
flavorText: More advanced blacksmiths carefully measure the heat of their fires with this device. Traditionalists scoff at such a practice.
name: Dwarven Thermoscope

title: Daedric Shoe Horn
flavorText: This tool guides Daedric and often strangely formed heels into stubbornly narrow mortal shoes.
name: Daedric Shoe Horn

title: Empty Skooma Vial
flavorText: This small glass vial still has a few skooma crystals at the bottom.
name: Empty Skooma Vial

title: Weird Moon-Sugar Blend
flavorText: A small parcel contains white crystals wrapped in Apocryphal leaves. Leaning close, you can hear it whispering.
name: Weird Moon-Sugar Blend

title: Smuggler's Mushroom Pouch
flavorText: A well-worn pouch made from a single mushroom top, with a false bottom. Ingenious.
name: Smuggler's Mushroom Pouch

title: Necrom Skooma Pipe
flavorText: An ornate pipe made of glass with brass fittings. It smells of apricots and cardamom.
name: Necrom Skooma Pipe

title: Skooma Cat Medallion
flavorText: A medallion to Sheogorath in his form as Skooma Cat. The cat is smiling at you.
name: Skooma Cat Medallion

title: Scrap of Skooma-Inspired Poetry
flavorText: This scrawled bit of doggerel was written in the throes of a skooma trip. It is bad poetry. Really bad.
name: Scrap of Skooma-Inspired Poetry

title: Nix-Ox Pull Toy
flavorText: This wooden toy has rollers mounted on its underside. When you pull it across the floor, its legs thrash back and forth.
name: Nix-Ox Pull Toy

title: Spirit Clackers
flavorText: Two stone balls are connected  by a leather strap. The noise of them clacking together keep ghosts (and other people) away.
name: Spirit Clackers

title: Watchling-On-A-String
flavorText: This is a thin pole with a stuffed Watchling attached on the end of a string.
name: Watchling-On-A-String

title: Glass Ghost Marionette
flavorText: This string puppet is made of colored glass, and used in popular street fair shows.
name: Glass Ghost Marionette

title: Hermaeus Mora Ball
flavorText: A toy ball in the shape of Hermaeus Mora. When you squeeze it, the central eye pops out.
name: Hermaeus Mora Ball

title: Ancestor Kite
flavorText: A delicate structure that catches the slightest breeze. Spectral banners drape behind it as it takes to the sky.
name: Ancestor Kite

title: Dark Elf Tajine
flavorText: A shallow earthenware vessel, used to prepare ragouts and other heavily-stewed dishes.
name: Dark Elf Tajine

title: Shalk Roasting Pan
flavorText: A lidded heavy pan used to slow-roast shalks. It can be used as a serving vessel as well.
name: Shalk Roasting Pan

title: Octopus-Shaped Teapot
flavorText: A leaded glass vase wrapped in tendrils of orichalc. The user needs to make sure which is the handle, and which is the spout.
name: Octopus-Shaped Teapot

title: Telvanni Cheese Press
flavorText: This is an ornate device of hardwood and bronze fittings, used to make Necrom beetle-cheese poutine.
name: Telvanni Cheese Press

title: Abyssal Charger
flavorText: Emblazoned with a scene looking out at the dark waters of the Apocryphal sea, this is the plate you put underneath your plate.
name: Abyssal Charger

title: Commemorative Erotic Crockery
flavorText: Extremely well-crafted, finely detailed, and etched with a limited edition marking for a specific occasion.
name: Commemorative Erotic Crockery

title: Dead Keeper's Shackles
flavorText: Heavy, cold-iron manacles used by the Necrom guards to keep recalcitrant undead in line.
name: Dead Keeper's Shackles

title: Cipher's Warrant Card
flavorText: A scrap of parchment inscribed with shifting runes, used by the Ciphers of the Eye in Apocrypha for identification.
name: Cipher's Warrant Card

title: Necrom Citation Book
flavorText: A small book of petty crimes and fines assigned. This one looks almost full.
name: Necrom Citation Book

title: Antique Magecatcher
flavorText: A set of rune-etched clamps at the end of a pole, used by guards to keep mage criminals at a distance.
name: Antique Magecatcher

title: Cryptguard Lantern
flavorText: The luminescence night moths within provide a soft glow as the tomb guardians make their rounds.
name: Cryptguard Lantern

title: Necromic Siren
flavorText: A megaphone used for crowd control and announcements. Loud enough to wake the dead.
name: Necromic Siren

title: Wooden Guar Whistle
flavorText: Ralen Tenaran describes using whistles to train Guar in his text "The Guarherder's Art".
name: Wooden Guar Whistle

title: Lurkerclaw Tools
flavorText: Several small tools -trowels, hand rakes and small shovels, all made of sinewy skin and reinforced bone.
name: Lurkerclaw Tools

title: Anointed Shovel
flavorText: Marked with the symbol of Necrom, these tools are used primarily for interring the dark elf ancestors.
name: Anointed Shovel

title: Daedrat Traps
flavorText: Made to catch the persistent menaces across the planes of Oblivion, these rusted traps still exude weak magic.
name: Daedrat Traps

title: Oraculan Augers
flavorText: Masterwork tools created by the Dark Elf smith Oracula, these drills can pierce the hardest of woods and fungi.
name: Oraculan Augers

title: Hollow Horseshoes
flavorText: Lightweight shoes used for parade events, they leave rune in the dirt venerating the ancestors.
name: Hollow Horseshoes

title: Kresh Tailor's Kit
flavorText: A small pouch containing kreshwork patches, copper metallic thread, and hardwood needles.  Used for field repairs.
name: Kresh Tailor's Kit

title: Kwama Boot Polish
flavorText: A tin of gooey kwama egg albumen. Smells horrible, but gives leather a nice reddish sheen.
name: Kwama Boot Polish

title: Runesmith's Engraving Lens
flavorText: A crystalline lens set in a brass mounting, attached to a headband to allow the crafter to use both hands when engraving.
name: Runesmith's Engraving Lens

title: Animated Bone Needles
flavorText: A set of magical knitting needles that never drop a stich, made of the legbones of some antedivulean creature.
name: Animated Bone Needles

title: Semi-Precious Gem Buttons
flavorText: A handful of flawed beryls, aquamarines, and chalcedonies marked with ancestral runes, made into coat buttons.
name: Semi-Precious Gem Buttons

title: House Dres Cameo Broach
flavorText: A finely-wrought portrait of a young dark elf maiden, made of layers of black and white agate.
name: House Dres Cameo Broach

title: Blood-mix Chalice
flavorText: A chalice you might see in any corner club, with a vial in the stem to mix blood into a more socially acceptable drink.
name: Blood-mix Chalice

title: Exsanguination Tools
flavorText: A flat leather poach containing small knives. Includes a diagram showing the carotid arteries for various creatures.
name: Exsanguination Tools

title: Dried Blood Rations
flavorText: Thin sheets of dried blood. They have a leathery  texture, and can be stored for a snack while walking the planes of Oblivion.
name: Dried Blood Rations

title: Umbral Parasol
flavorText: A black umbrella, used to protect vampires (or the melancholic) from the hated rays of the sun.
name: Umbral Parasol

title: Emblem of Lamae Bal
flavorText: A small disk with a portrait of Lamae Bal, the first vampire, who is call Mother Lamae or the Blood Matron.
name: Emblem of Lamae Bal

title: Vampiric Doll
flavorText: A hideous doll made of cloth, leather, and what looks like real hair and fangs. An effigy to make children fear vampires early.
name: Vampiric Doll

title: Valkynazian Baton
flavorText: A symbol of authority among the Dremora, this thin staff is made from the bone of a holy warrior, embossed with golden runes.
name: Valkynazian Baton

title: Easy-Apply Kohl Stick
flavorText: A soft stick made from, among other things, ash-salts and night-oil. Wrapped in wax paper to maintain its pencil shape.
name: Easy-Apply Kohl Stick

title: Tomeshell Leather Hair Ties
flavorText: Supple tendrils of leather weighted at the ends with rubedite beads. Used for tying hair out of one's face.
name: Tomeshell Leather Hair Ties

title: Kwama Egg Cold Cream
flavorText: The slight burning sensation from applying this slimy moisturizer is what lets you know that it's working.
name: Kwama Egg Cold Cream

title: Black Anther Perfume
flavorText: A glowing bottle of high-end perfume complete with a tasseled atomizer. Its spritzed scent makes you weak in the knees.
name: Black Anther Perfume

title: Beauty Beholder's Mud Mask
flavorText: A jar of inky, oil-sheened mud promising radiant skin and boasting to have been harvested from the rivers of Chroma Incognita.
name: Beauty Beholder's Mud Mask

title: Dark Talons Nail Lacquer
flavorText: This quick-drying, lethal-looking nail lacquer is made from nightshade, scrib jelly, and powderized black pearl.
name: Dark Talons Nail Lacquer

title: Shadowspun Prayer Mat
flavorText: This padded mat made from soft void cloth is used primarily by mourners in Necrom.
name: Shadowspun Prayer Mat

title: Ashen Glaze of the Inevitable Knower
flavorText: A jar of fine glaze derived from Apocryphal plants, used to apply glassy blue markings on finished pottery.
name: Ashen Glaze of the Inevitable Knower

title: Sham of Saint Meris
flavorText: A pillowcase of fine linen embroidered with prayers invoking Saint Merys the Wise to grant nights of deep, restful sleep.
name: Sham of Saint Meris

title: Wristband of the Tide King
flavorText: A silver spiral wristband molded in the shape of a multi-eyed sea snake. Its fangs are bared and sharp enough to draw blood.
name: Wristband of the Tide King

title: Prayer Beads of Saint Vorys
flavorText: The crest of House Telvanni, wrought in voidstone, hangs on this loop of lustrous beads of pure moonstone.
name: Prayer Beads of Saint Vorys

title: Firesteel of the Immolant One
flavorText: A ritualistic pyrite and flint firestriker, embossed with the likeness of Saint Vorys.
name: Firesteel of the Immolant One

title: Fungal Fermentation Kit
flavorText: A jar, cover, and sealed packet of live culture for at-home brewing of alcoholic beverages.
name: Fungal Fermentation Kit

title: Flin Flask
flavorText: A pewter hip flask filled with strong blended flin, typically sold to Necrom mourners to aid in discreet drinking.
name: Flin Flask

title: Spumy Liqueur
flavorText: A double-distilled sweet digestif bottled in Cipher's Midden, made with a fragrant mix of berries and Apocryphal slime.
name: Spumy Liqueur

title: Freckled Guar Shein
flavorText: A limited-edition bottle of Sour Guar Shein, flavored with suspended guarana seeds that lend its freckled appearance.
name: Freckled Guar Shein

title: Poison-Detecting Enchanted Goblet
flavorText: Favored by the Mouths of the Telvanni, the rim of this bronze goblet is enchanted to glow white at the presence of poison.
name: Poison-Detecting Enchanted Goblet

title: Apocryphal Bottle Stoppers
flavorText: A set of three cork-like bottle stoppers molded in the shape of tentacles, each representing an aspect of Hermaeus Mora.
name: Apocryphal Bottle Stoppers

title: Eel Tongs
flavorText: A long, sturdy pair of foreceps used by nocturnal fishermen to pluck unsuspecting eels from brackish water.
name: Eel Tongs

title: Mussel Knife
flavorText: A comically small blade on a wooden handle used for prying open mussels.
name: Mussel Knife

title: Slipshod's Rod Holder
flavorText: A chest harness that prevents the user from dropping or losing their rod to strong catches or swift currents.
name: Slipshod's Rod Holder

title: Quillfeather Lure Set
flavorText: Inter-planar anglers claim these ink-stained lures attract the underwater creatures of Apocrypha.
name: Quillfeather Lure Set

title: Magma Waders
flavorText: Why someone would need these stiff, enchanted overalls to go safely fishing in lava is anyone's guess.
name: Magma Waders

title: Seeker Tendril Lure
flavorText: Attached to the end of a fishing line, this appendage grabs fish rather than hooks them. Just be sure it doesn't grab you.
name: Seeker Tendril Lure

title: Songbook for Beginner Buskers
flavorText: A simple and instructive book of lyrics to the most overplayed songs in the region.
name: Songbook for Beginner Buskers

title: Lurkerskin Drum
flavorText: When struck, this rune-etched drum resonates with a hideous, unnerving thrum.
name: Lurkerskin Drum

title: Scrib Warble Whistle
flavorText: When filled with water, this small wooden whistle carved in the shape of a scrib makes a noise just like a scrib.
name: Scrib Warble Whistle

title: Beautiful Mourning: One Thousand Dirges of Necrom
flavorText: A pocket-sized hymnal offering short dirges and elegies that attempt to convey the depth of any imaginable loss.
name: Beautiful Mourning: One Thousand Dirges of Necrom

title: In Remembrance of Master Scaly-Tale
flavorText: Orchestral sheet music for a many-movement funeral march marking the passing of a beloved pet.
name: In Remembrance of Master Scaly-Tale

title: Antediluvian Hunting Horn
flavorText: A heavy horn made from an ancient fossil, engraved with a depiction of Hermaeus Mora driving beasts before him.
name: Antediluvian Hunting Horn

title: Guarhide Apron
flavorText: This thick, heavy apron falls past your knees and protects you from most molten materials.
name: Guarhide Apron

title: Abyssal Punty and Blowpipe
flavorText: A pair of tools made from tarnished brass, used by the Ciphers of the Eye to blow glass.
name: Abyssal Punty and Blowpipe

title: Ceramic Urn Slip Cast
flavorText: A plaster mold for a simple and small funerary urn.
name: Ceramic Urn Slip Cast

title: Lapidary's Tool Kit
flavorText: A set of fine hand tools used in the craft of shaping and setting gemstones.
name: Lapidary's Tool Kit

title: Telvanni Sigil Die Cutting Set
flavorText: This small tool seems capable of cutting the sigil of House Telvanni from wood, leather, or soft metal.
name: Telvanni Sigil Die Cutting Set

title: Arcane Leather Stamping Tools
flavorText: A small set of tools intended for leatherworking. The sigils and glyphs in the stamps are obscure and distressing.
name: Arcane Leather Stamping Tools

title: If It Were Your Ancestor
flavorText: A reminder notice to visitors not to meddle with flowers, caskets, candles, and urns on the street of Necrom.
name: If It Were Your Ancestor

title: Morag Tong Visitor's Notice
flavorText: A sheaf of parchment priming outsiders to the presence of the Morag Tong and urging not to interfere with their business.
name: Morag Tong Visitor's Notice

title: Sailenmora Traveler's Brochure
flavorText: A short, somewhat desperate leaflet urging travelers and pilgrims alike to visit the Shrine of Saint Vorys in Sailenmora.
name: Sailenmora Traveler's Brochure

title: Turifa's Alchemy Notes
flavorText: A private notebook filled with creative fiction and euphemisms rather than scholarly observations on alchemical ingredients.
name: Turifa's Alchemy Notes

title: Kemel-Ze Visitor's Map
flavorText: This map identifies more passages where visitors are not allowed than where they are.
name: Kemel-Ze Visitor's Map

title: Crude Chroma Scrawl
flavorText: An attempt to outline the features of Chroma Incognita gives way to frantic scribblings in a language you've never seen before.
name: Crude Chroma Scrawl

title: Fungal Poppet
flavorText: Fashioned from dried fungal stalks, this figurine probably made a strange Telvanni child quite happy.
name: Fungal Poppet

title: Tome-Torn Paper Doll
flavorText: A child snipped this from a forbidden tome and scribbled over its arcane runes. Hopefully, they had not yet learned to read.
name: Tome-Torn Paper Doll

title: Stuffed Silt Strider
flavorText: A bladder inside this plush arthropod emits a low groan when squeezed.
name: Stuffed Silt Strider

title: Mother Morrowind Doll
flavorText: Hewn from imported wood and lovingly painted, this doll bears Almalexia's likeness. A darling but vaguely blasphemous toy.
name: Mother Morrowind Doll

title: Ordinator Marionette
flavorText: Nerevar's imperious visage is just as intimidating on this puppet as it is on the Tribunal's chosen warriors.
name: Ordinator Marionette

title: Unnerving Rag Doll
flavorText: This sackcloth dolly's dead expression is unsettling, but the quivering mass of flesh in its stuffed head is the real terror.
name: Unnerving Rag Doll

title: Oathman's Kerchief
flavorText: This maroon kerchief bears the sigil of the infamous Magister Gothren.
name: Oathman's Kerchief

title: Laboratory Tablecloth
flavorText: A well-worn covering for laboratory tables. Some of the darker stains are more than a little unnerving.
name: Laboratory Tablecloth

title: Argonian-Made Doily
flavorText: Clearly fashioned by Argonian hands, this crocheted doily merges Blackmarsh and Morrowind aesthetics into a single design.
name: Argonian-Made Doily

title: Fungal Potpourri Pillow
flavorText: A silky pillow filled with aromatic dried fungus. Perfect for wizards seeking inspiring and productive dreams.
name: Fungal Potpourri Pillow

title: Quivering Quilt
flavorText: Rather than cloth, the patches of this disquieting quilt are fashioned from paper, vellum, and living flesh.
name: Quivering Quilt

title: Wizarding Wipe
flavorText: This stark white cloth removes grit, grime, and staining fluids but never loses its pristine appearance.
name: Wizarding Wipe

title: Divining Tooth
flavorText: When placed in a clay vessel, this rune-covered Dremora molar will clatter truthful answers to "yes or no" questions.
name: Divining Tooth

title: Scrib Flute
flavorText: A pan flute made from pieces of scrib chitin. When played, any scribs nearby perform a curious tapping-foot dance.
name: Scrib Flute

title: Red Mountain Ashglobe
flavorText: A small glass globe containing a miniature mushroom tower. Tiny ash flakes fall on the tower when the globe is examined.
name: Red Mountain Ashglobe

title: Malachite Fleshfly
flavorText: This thumb-sized figurine emits a buzzing sound in the presence of a corpse, providing confirmation of death.
name: Malachite Fleshfly

title: Vial of "Dwemer Dust"
flavorText: A label claims this "contains a pinch of dust left behind by Dwemer who disappeared during the Battle of Red Mountain."
name: Vial of "Dwemer Dust"

title: Golden Tentacle Ocular
flavorText: A golden reading lens shaped like a curling tentacle. It reveals glimpses of the author's thoughts alongside the actual text.
name: Golden Tentacle Ocular

title: Aromatic Trama Shavings
flavorText: A pouch full of shavings from the trama shrub of the Ashlands. Often added to Necrom cremations to produce a pleasant smoke.
name: Aromatic Trama Shavings

title: Black Lichen Wound Salve
flavorText: Kwama miners of Morrowind use a paste made of black lichen to prevent cuts  from becoming infected.
name: Black Lichen Wound Salve

title: Pickled Tomeshell Tongue
flavorText: Sticky, slimy, and tough. Any other properties it may possess are so far undiscovered.
name: Pickled Tomeshell Tongue

title: Articulated Silver Tentacles
flavorText: A pair of nimble prosthetic tentacles, specifically designed to replace the ring finger and pinkie of a left hand.
name: Articulated Silver Tentacles

title: Healing Mother's Prayer Cloth
flavorText: A strip of fine cloth, embroidered with sacred glyphs. Said to have been blessed by Almalexia herself.
name: Healing Mother's Prayer Cloth

title: Xylaria Dreaming Powder
flavorText: This silk pouch contains a powder made from the specially treated spores of the giant xylaria. It's said to bestow vivid dreams.
name: Xylaria Dreaming Powder

title: Mage Turoth's Funerary Ash
flavorText: A pouch of ash from the funerary fire of a notable personage. Whether Turoth the mage was notable or not, who can say?
name: Mage Turoth's Funerary Ash

title: Watchling-Hide Jester Bauble
flavorText: A small, stuffed Watchling mounted on a puppeteer's stick. A grim and curious jest indeed.
name: Watchling-Hide Jester Bauble

title: Degraded Dwemer Quarrel
flavorText: Some Dwemer automata were armed with self-loading crossbows. This small dart was made to be fired from such a device.
name: Degraded Dwemer Quarrel

title: Necrom Death Mask
flavorText: A fine clay mask memorializing the features of a Dark Elf noble from Necrom's ancient vaults. The expression is rather cruel.
name: Necrom Death Mask

title: Bronzed Hands Reading Stand
flavorText: The hands of some forgotten scholar, preserved in bronze and fashioned into a reading stand for a spellbook.
name: Bronzed Hands Reading Stand

title: Grahl-Eye Gem Purse
flavorText: The mummified third eye of a huge ice troll. Now used as  a tough, leathery pouch for knick-knacks and valuables.
name: Grahl-Eye Gem Purse

title: Alit Coin Bank
flavorText: This child's coin bank is shaped like a chubby alit and painted in bright colors. One coin rattles inside when shaken.
name: Alit Coin Bank

title: Amber Keeper Totem
flavorText: A crudely carved figurine of a Keeper made from amber of a fiery gold hue and scribed with strange runes.
name: Amber Keeper Totem

title: Ordinator Bookend
flavorText: A heavy pewter piece depicting a watchful temple ordinator in armor. The matching bookend is nowhere to be found.
name: Ordinator Bookend

title: Silver Nix-Hound Paperweight
flavorText: An abstract interpretation of a nix-hound, made from good silver. Small rubies represent its many eyes.
name: Silver Nix-Hound Paperweight

title: Telvanni Magister Statuette
flavorText: A handsome ebony carving of a Telvanni magister in full ceremonial robes.
name: Telvanni Magister Statuette

title: Malachite Watchling Figure
flavorText: An exquisitely detailed carving of a Watchling in translucent green crystal. Lovely, yet disquieting.
name: Malachite Watchling Figure

title: Cultist Eyestone
flavorText: A smooth pebble engraved with a primitive symbol: an eye ringed by three wavy lines, an ancient symbol for Hermaeus Mora.
name: Cultist Eyestone

title: Bantam Guar Doorstop
flavorText: A life-sized figurine of a bantam guar, carved from petrified fungal stalk. Heavy, but it does the job.
name: Bantam Guar Doorstop

title: Glass Orb Dovah-Fly
flavorText: A pretty blue dovah-fly, embedded in a small glass orb. How did they put it in there, anyway?
name: Glass Orb Dovah-Fly

title: Gilded Spore Print Box
flavorText: A small box whose top is decorated with spore prints that have been traced out in fine gold filigree.
name: Gilded Spore Print Box

title: Arcanist Dice Set
flavorText: A set of four ebony dice, each face depicts a different Arcanist concept. Do tentacles represent good luck or bad?
name: Arcanist Dice Set

title: Necrom Ancestral Incense Smoker
flavorText: This porcelain vessel depicts a lordly Dark Elf in his final repose. Burning incense produces smoke from the lord's nostrils.
name: Necrom Ancestral Incense Smoker

title: Reliquary of Prior Durdryn
flavorText: This sealed glass vessel contains a tooth said to have belonged to Prior Durdryn, founder of Necrom Abbey.
name: Reliquary of Prior Durdryn

title: Saint Vorys's Testament
flavorText: Preserved in a tooled leather case, this ancient prayer scroll was purportedly written by Saint Vorys the Immolant himself.
name: Saint Vorys's Testament

title: Bottled Butterfly
flavorText: A clear alchemy bottle holding the likeness of a butterfly with intricate wings of mirrored glass. How did it get in there?
name: Bottled Butterfly

title: Alchemist Survey: Apocrypha
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Alchemist Survey: Apocrypha

title: Enchanter Survey: Apocrypha
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Enchanter Survey: Apocrypha

title: Clothier Survey: Apocrypha
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Clothier Survey: Apocrypha

title: Blacksmith Survey: Telvanni Peninsula
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Blacksmith Survey: Telvanni Peninsula

title: Structural Recipes: Update 49
flavorText: This envelope contains the 34 new Furniture Recipes that will be introduced into the Solstice Reward Coffers from Delve and World Bosses. Update 49.
name: Structural Recipes: Update 49

title: Necrom Treasure Hunter's Parcel
flavorText: This container holds a selection of treasure maps, to be put to the test by would-be treasure hunters.
name: Necrom Treasure Hunter's Parcel

title: Jewelry Crafting Survey: Telvanni Peninsula
flavorText: A rare report indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Jewelry Crafting Survey: Telvanni Peninsula

title: Gold Road Recipe Envelope 2
flavorText: This envelope contains a variety of Furniture Recipes to be introduced in the Gold Road update.
name: Gold Road Recipe Envelope 2

title: Gold Road Recipe Envelope 3
flavorText: This envelope contains a variety of Furniture Recipes to be introduced in the Gold Road update.
name: Gold Road Recipe Envelope 3

title: Woodworker Survey: Telvanni Peninsula
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Woodworker Survey: Telvanni Peninsula

title: Survey Reports - Necrom
flavorText: A compendium of every survey report recorded in Necrom.
name: Survey Reports - Necrom

title: Wardrobe of Tel Var Outfits
flavorText: An decorative wardrobe containing many collectible Outfit Styles. If you know all available Outfit Styles already, this container does nothing.
name: Wardrobe of Tel Var Outfits

title: Illuminated Halosaur
flavorText: An abyssal fish. Use to filet for provisioning.
name: Illuminated Halosaur

title: Caliginous Bristleworm
flavorText: An abyssal fish. Use to filet for provisioning.
name: Caliginous Bristleworm

title: Wardrobe of Scribes of Fate Outfits
flavorText: An decorative wardrobe containing many collectible Outfit Styles. If you know all available Outfit Styles already, this container does nothing.
name: Wardrobe of Scribes of Fate Outfits

title: Wardrobe of Special Outfits II
flavorText: An decorative wardrobe containing many collectible Outfit Styles. If you know all available Outfit Styles already, this container does nothing.
name: Wardrobe of Special Outfits II

title: Assortment of Attractive Adornments
flavorText: An decorative wardrobe containing many collectible Adornments.
name: Assortment of Attractive Adornments

title: Wardrobe of Event Outfits
flavorText: An decorative wardrobe containing many collectible Outfit Styles. If you know all available Outfit Styles already, this container does nothing.
name: Wardrobe of Event Outfits

title: Runebox: Face-Eating Tome Memento
flavorText: Contains a Face-Eating Tome Memento. This container can be traded, mailed, and posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores. NOTE: Once opened, the Runebox and its contents are bound to your account.
name: Runebox: Face-Eating Tome Memento

title: Jewelry: Perfected Ansuul's Torment
flavorText: A Medium Armor set found in Sanity's Edge.
name: Jewelry: Perfected Ansuul's Torment

title: Furnishing Pack: Necrom Garden
flavorText: When you need a break from the rigors of research or strenuous adventures, enjoy a quiet Necrom-themed nook in your home. Including a gazebo, statuary, fungi, and more, this pack may inspire your inner mycoturge into a great feat of gardening.
name: Furnishing Pack: Necrom Garden

title: Vision of Mora
flavorText: This glimmering carving is still imbued with the latent power of the Infinite Archive. This is a small house item. When placed in your home, allows you to interact with the latent magic of the Archive.
name: Vision of Mora

title: Style Page: Thane of Falkreath Cuirass
flavorText: Grants an Outfit Style Collectible. Once used, the Outfit Style is available to all characters on your account. Outfit Styles can be used at an Outfit Station to customize your appearance.
name: Style Page: Thane of Falkreath Cuirass

title: Style Page: Thane of Falkreath Helm
flavorText: Grants an Outfit Style Collectible. Once used, the Outfit Style is available to all characters on your account. Outfit Styles can be used at an Outfit Station to customize your appearance.
name: Style Page: Thane of Falkreath Helm

title: Boots of Bahraha's Curse
name: Boots of Bahraha's Curse

setBonuses.description: (4 items) Reduces your damage taken from environmental traps by 40%.

(5 items) When you deal damage, you have a |cffffff25|r% chance to create desecrated ground for |cffffff5|r seconds, which reduces the Movement Speed of enemies within |cffffff3.5|r meters by 60%, damages them for 492 Magic damage every |cffffff1|r second, and heals you for |cffffff100|r% of the damage done. This effect can occur once every |cffffff5|r seconds and the damage scales off your Max Health.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge and Sprint by 1.2%.
